description: Hardcoded knowledge for Backend Developer Agent - no codebase search needed

coreLearnings.content: Backend uses Spring Boot 3.x with Java, JPA, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets
317 Java source files organized in package mls.sho.dms.application.*
Modules: analytics, core, costing, engineering, inventory, kds, pos, primecost, purchasing, seeder, simulator, users

Controllers: AnalyticsController, ReportController, MenuController, RecipeController, EngineeringController, IngredientController, InventoryController, InventoryIntelligenceController, InventoryStatsController, CentralKdsController, ExpoKdsController, StationKdsController, MenuItemConfigController, PosController, GoodsReceiptController, PurchasingController, SupplierController, GuestAuthController, OnboardingController

Key Entities: Restaurant, DiningTable, TableSession, Order, OrderLine, Ingredient, MenuItem, Recipe, RecipeIngredientLine, RecipeProcedureStep, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine, PurchaseInvoice, PurchaseInvoiceLine, GoodsReceipt, GoodsReceiptLine, Supplier, InventoryActiveLot, InventoryIngredientLedger, InventoryWasteRegistry, MenuCostGroup
Security: Spring Security with OAuth2, JWT/DPoP, Google Authenticator for 2FA
Database: PostgreSQL with Flyway migrations (migration folder exists but empty - using Hibernate)
Caching: Redis for session management and caching
Real-time: WebSockets with STOMP for KDS (Kitchen Display System) synchronization
AI Features: PDF invoice parsing (PDFBox), OCR (Tesseract), 3-way matching with Apache PDFBox, OpenCV, JGraphT
Business Simulation: Built-in simulator for inventory, sales, waste scenarios in simulator module
Seeders: AfghanIngredientSeeder, DashboardDataSeeder, ExperimentDataSeeder, KdsDataSeeder, MenuCostingSeeder, ShoProUserSeeder
Inventory features: FIFO tracking, lot management, waste registry, physical inventory periods, ingredient costing
Purchasing: Supplier management, purchase orders, goods receipts, 3-way invoice matching with AI
KDS: CentralKds, ExpoKds, StationKds with real-time order status updates via WebSocket

patternsEstablished: REST Controllers return DTOs, not entities - use @RestController annotation
Services contain business logic, Controllers handle HTTP request/response
Repositories extend JpaRepository for standard CRUD
Use @Transactional for service methods modifying data
WebSocket endpoints use @MessageMapping for STOMP destinations
knownPitfalls: Flyway migration folder is empty - ensure proper migration strategy
Large number of entities may need optimization with indexes
Consider adding OpenAPI documentation to all endpoints
AI features (OCR, 3-way matching) need proper error handling for edge cases
OAuth2Service requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET env vars - defaults in application.yml
WebSocket STOMP endpoints need /topic/ and /queue/ prefixes

commonErrors.401/403 errors: Verify JWT token validation and role permissions
